definitions.delta_metric: compressed minus same-model same-weight B0; percentage points
definitions.delta_rank: after minus before, one-based complete positive video rank; negative is better
definitions.seed_comparison_direction: seed9527 before, seed20261024 after; same IDs and GT
definitions.quantile: NumPy linear, all queries including zero deltas
definitions.margin: float64(GT float32 score) minus float64(max other-video float32 score); strict signs, no tolerance
definitions.ranking: original per-row torch.argsort(-score_row, stable=False), CPU; independently checked rank bounds
definitions.baseline_padding: B0 original zero-padded 128 frame score is unmasked; compressed ragged padding is excluded
definitions.ward: <REVISION> ward_all verbatim: cosine dissimilarity, SciPy Ward linkage, fcluster maxclust, raw mean then fp32
definitions.uniform: <REVISION> valid_length_pool, only 32/33 generalized to k/k+1; L<k keeps L raw vectors
definitions.kmeans: <REVISION> fit verbatim, raw Euclidean float64, seed20261023 per video, n_init10/max_iter300/tol1e-4; L<=32 keeps raw
definitions.two_branch: <REVISION>: identical Ward on 32 raw clip outputs to 8 and valid raw frame outputs to 8
